title: NCLAT reshuffle: Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma to go to Delhi, Justice Seshasayee to Chennai
description: Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma, Judicial Member of the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT), is likely to move from the tribunal’s Chennai Bench to its Principal Bench in New Delhi from July 20, sources told Bar & Bench. Justice N Seshasayee, who was appointed as a Judicial Member of the NCLAT last year, is likely to sit at the Chennai Bench from the same date.These changes are expected to be notified shortly.
